citation: [The 2000 block of Prairie Avenue looking north from 21st Street, c. 1880.] Engraved street view; engraver and first publication not named. Reproduced on chicagology.com, 2036 Prairie, whose caption puts the Buckingham house at the far left in 1880.
author: unknown engraver
describes_date: 1875-1885 (the Prairie library's bracket on the caption's 1880)
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a20-chicagology-2036-street-engraving-1880, recorded there as 'unknown - link only'; the project's reference copy is the image store's (kevinrhaas/chicago-images, prairie-1904/files/a20-chicagology-2036-street-engraving-1880.jpg), committed at data/sources/assets/buckingham_2036_pictures_t1911/.
locator: The left third of the print (x 0-650 of 2000): 2036's 21st Street face, its canted south-east corner and the edge of its Prairie front with the stoop, cut off by the frame above the chamber storey; 2026 Prairie's pale Second Empire flank and towered front beyond it (x 650-1150).
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset (no texture, no traced mesh), and the copy is unaltered.
access_notes: Read 2026-11-17 (T-1911) from the image store's reference copy, 2000 x 1198 px greyscale, sha256 9247cf9c0e5a7a890e21fe96b256f9067b45256822aebef55e376de67e1d036a. Its camera is solved on 2036's own window column, cant and front (data/reference_views/buckingham_house_2036_prairie/chicagology_engraving.json); the engraver's foreground (the fence, the gate's urn piers) does not stand in the same perspective as the house and is not used for the fit.
note: The one near view of 2036: a brick house over a stone basement cut in broad horizontal courses, its 21st Street face with a tall principal light under a hood (a cornice over a frieze carved with a running vine, on consoles) and a chamber light over it standing on a stone sill course, a barred basement light; the south-east corner cut on a narrow face hidden by a tree; on the Prairie front a pale column at the head of a broad stoop with turned balusters running down to the walk; an iron fence of spear bars over a band of rings on a stone curb, with urns on the gate piers. The frame stops above the chamber storey, so the cornice and roof are not shown.
what_it_supplies: 2036's walls, basement, principal and chamber lights, hood and sill course on its 21st Street face, and their heights through the solved camera
the cant at the south-east corner, the porch's column and the stoop's balustrade on the Prairie front
the iron fence's pattern and the urn piers at the gate
2026 Prairie's south flank and towered front beyond (T-3608's house)
what_it_does_not_supply: 2036's cornice, roof, dormers and chimneys (out of the frame)
the rear and the north flank
a date closer than about 1875-1885, and the 1904 state: alterations after the engraving are not shown
